name: Gatterfly
look: a huge butterfly of black coal with glowing cracks, ruby compound eyes, Gatling-gun arms whose barrel drums glow white-hot at the muzzle, and four wings made of fire
entry: Its arms have become guns that spray stingers so fast and so hot they glow, and its wings are made of fire. Besides fighting with them, it melts stone with its flames to build its nest.
how: Evolve Cinderoon at level 36. Learns its own move, Machine Gun Stinger, when it evolves.
